features.body: Whenever the hellhound makes a strike against a creature while rampaging, they can cause a target who has P < AVERAGE to be [frightened](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/condition/frightened) until the end of the target's next turn.
features.name: Infernal Apparition

features.body: While the hellhound is rampaging, your mouth foams with acidic ichor, and whenever you make a strike against a creature, you deal extra acid damage equal to your Might score.
features.name: Slavering Jaws

features.body: While the hellhound is rampaging, you and the hellhound are surrounded by an aura of flames, and each enemy who starts their turn adjacent to you or the hellhound takes fire damage equal to the hellhound's Might score.
features.name: Wreathed in Flames
